ValidationRule.description: Prevents a user from unchecking the BU checkbox that matches Business_Unit__c. Fires only when that checkbox is changed to unchecked, so existing mismatched records are not blocked. Changing Business_Unit__c in the same save releases the lock.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Lead_Validation), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "ALM"), ISCHANGED(ALM_BU__c), NOT(ALM_BU__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "RIM"), ISCHANGED(RIM_BU__c), NOT(RIM_BU__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "Digital"), ISCHANGED(Digital_BU__c), NOT(Digital_BU__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "W&L"), ISCHANGED(W_L_BU__c), NOT(W_L_BU__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Business_Unit__c, "MAS"), ISCHANGED(MAS_BU__c), NOT(MAS_BU__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The BU checkbox that matches the Primary Business Unit cannot be unchecked. Change the Primary Business Unit (or Primary Product Interest) first.
